method: git show and git diff of two exact local commit objects; current source and repository evidence inspected, no runtime repeated

features.originalAlreadyHad: No scripts directory or migration CLI in the inspected upstream commit tree. Original supported configuring the theme in Halo; this check does not prove there were no off-repository migration tools.
features.provenDifference: A local CLI reads grouped JSON or ConfigMap JSON/YAML and converts known 2.0.5/2.0.7 fields to the separate Next theme. It preserves false/empty arrays, emits field-level unsupported/type-mismatch/manual-review actions, creates new files with wx and 0600, and does not call Halo.
features.consumerValue: Helps an existing original-theme user prepare a switch and inspect unsupported fields before importing. This is a switching aid, not a new blogging feature or proof of a fundamentally different product.
limits: Not full data or content migration
Does not import into Halo automatically

features.originalAlreadyHad: Original AmplifyImg used Fancybox and grouped page images. Its toolbar explicitly provided zoom, 1:1, rotate, flip, slideshow, thumbnails and close; these must not be marketed as new features.
features.provenDifference: Current adapter uses bundled Viewer.js. Source explicitly preserves ordinary/download links and modified clicks; accepts data-no-lightbox; honors explicit lightbox groups; derives lazy/current source at open; observes added images; avoids duplicate registration; adds focusable triggers, Chinese labels, background inert preservation and trigger-focus restoration.
features.consumerValue: A maintained image-viewing integration with clearer keyboard/link/lazy-image handling and an MIT runtime dependency. Library replacement or rewrite alone is not independent market differentiation.
limits: Original Fancybox library itself may already provide some accessibility and focus behaviors; no claim that original had none
No global quality or performance superiority proven
Synthetic cross-engine evidence is not current final Halo ZIP coverage or physical device testing

features.originalAlreadyHad: Original provided author, announcement, category, tag and site-information cards; basic card enable switches, global positioning and site uptime existed. Category list requested 5 and tags 25. These are inherited capabilities.
features.provenDifference: Current source adds page-type visibility, author/announcement toggles, configurable card ordering, category tree/limit/expand behavior, tag sort-before-limit, year/month archive card with ordering/format/limit, and individual site-information fields.
features.consumerValue: Site owners can choose sidebar content and organize larger taxonomies without editing templates. This is a functional configuration expansion relative to the inspected Halo port; many options align with Hexo Butterfly and are not original inventions.
limits: No latest-comment/custom/series cards added by this options change
Several sorting/tree behaviors depend on JS; bounded no-JS fallback differs
Archive source reads all public-post archives; large-site performance not established
Not full Moment date formatting or full matrix acceptance

features.originalAlreadyHad: Original used Halo main menus and icon annotations, rendered two levels, and opened a mobile sidebar with click-to-toggle children. Main menu and mobile drawer themselves are inherited.
features.provenDifference: Current recursive template supports deeper Halo trees; adds mobile default-collapse annotation, explicit disclosure buttons/ARIA state, Escape and focus handling, drawer background inert/scroll lock, overflow fallback, and exact route/current-page marking.
features.consumerValue: Accommodates multi-level or long menus and keyboard navigation more explicitly than the original adapter.
limits: No claim of full screen-reader, physical-device or Safari acceptance
Default mobile group behavior changes from collapsed to expanded unless hide is set

features.originalAlreadyHad: Original had Typed.js animation, custom multi-line strings, optional random API URL and configured JSON field path. Typing and remote quotes themselves are inherited.
features.provenDifference: Current adds explicit off/static controls; local-only and three named source adapters; validated declarative Typed options; safe string/path handling, bounded failures and local fallback instead of displaying configuration/fetch warnings.
features.consumerValue: Offers optional static/local-only presentation and predictable fallback, and lets owners tune timing without editing JavaScript.
limits: Three external source behaviors use synthetic responses in the cited testing; no live provider availability/CORS/SLA guarantee
Defaults intentionally retain old 200ms speed and enabled behavior
Typed options are a whitelist, not arbitrary callbacks/config
No claim of unique invention: several options adapt fixed Hexo Butterfly behavior

acceptanceBoundary.coverage: Bounded configuration and interaction scenarios only; not full per-entry acceptance
acceptanceBoundary.note: Historical bounded runtime/review evidence belongs to its exact recorded SHA, not automatically the current head. Current task inspected source differences only.

marketConclusion: Evidence supports describing an independently maintained derivative with migration assistance and expanded configuration/interaction behavior. It does not establish a wholly original theme, official succession, marketplace approval or unique value solely from code churn/test counts.
